description: Fixed effect estimates from AGENCY_LMM_FULL_ALL_DATA (all 2006-2014 data, n=134,358). All-data refit — not the source of holdout evaluation metrics. lme4 does not provide p-values for lmer by default (no denominator df for F-tests). t-values > 2 are generally considered significant in large-n contexts.
all_data_refit_note: Fixed effects from the all-data refit. The evaluated LMM is AGENCY_LMM_FULL (fit on 2006-2012 only).
p_value_note: lme4::lmer does not report p-values. t-values shown. For Satterthwaite or Kenward-Roger approximate p-values, use the lmerTest package.

fixed_effects.p_value_note: lme4 does not report p-values for lmer by default. Use lmerTest or Satterthwaite approximation if needed.
